## at__README.md
# Field boundaries for Austria

Provides 2944405 official field boundaries from Austria.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Agrarmarkt Austria (Government).

- **Source Data Provider:** [Agrarmarkt Austria (Government)](https://geometadatensuche.inspire.gv.at/metadatensuche/inspire/api/records/9db8a0c3-e92a-4df4-9d55-8210e326a7ed)
- **Converted by:** Matthias Mohr
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:31287 (MGI / Austria Lambert)
- **Data Survey:** https://github.com/fiboa/data-survey/blob/main/data/AT.md

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/data/at/at-2025.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/data/at/stac/collection.json)

- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/data/at/at-2025.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description                                                 |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| inspire:id             | string        | The INSPIRE identifier                                      |
| id                     | string        | Unique identifier                                           |
| determination:datetime | timestamp     | Timestamp of the determination of the field boundary        |
| metrics:area           | float         | Field area in square meters                                 |
| crop:code              | string        | The crop code                                               |
| hcat:name              | string        | The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop                  |
| hcat:name_en           | string        | The HCAT crop name translated into English                  |
| hcat:code              | uint32        | The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop |
| crop:name              | string        | Crop name in the original language                          |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2025-10-27 from:

- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.20.1
